plainText:
Sapphire (Japanese: ルビー Ruby) is a character from Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire who first appeared in Let's Try To Be Idols!!. She is based on from and is one of 's rivals.

==History==
Sapphire is a Pokémon Coordinator from Hoenn who introduced herself to Red when he entered the building with his Pokémon. Red takes a liking to her , seeing that it was the one that he was about to go on a journey with before going to Hoenn. Sapphire recommends him to partake in a Pokémon Contest in which Red does. When it was Sapphire turn to perform on stage, she manages to get a perfect score and wins the competition, placing Red in second place.

==Character==
Despite being rivals with Red during the Pokémon Contest both of them competed in, she was shown to have some friendly advice.

==Pokémon==
 

==Trivia==
Her and 's original names were switched in Chuang Yi's English translation of the manga, possibly to match the names of corresponding characters in Pokémon Adventures manga.
